Ting, David S-K. (Department of Mechanical, Automotive and Materials Engineering).
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains molecular dynamics (MD) simulation results for ice adhesion and interfacial melting on silver (Ag) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) substrates. The data include temperature-dependent adhesive strength, structural evolution characterized by tetrahedral order parameter, and detachment responses obtained through steered molecular dynamics simulations. The dataset supports the findings reported in the associated publication and provides a molecular-scale basis for understanding ice adhesion differences between metallic and polymeric surfaces under varying thermal and mechanical conditions.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: A Molecular Dynamics Comparison of Ice Adhesion on Silver and High-Density Polyethylene Substrates
